organizer.settings.language.switch: Switch your {count, plural, one {{count, number, ::group-off} open signup} other {{count, number, ::group-off} open signups}} to <language>{name}</language>
organizer.settings.language.switched: Saved. Your {count, plural, one {{count, number, ::group-off} open signup now uses} other {{count, number, ::group-off} open signups now use}} <language>{name}</language>.
organizer.connectedApps.title: Connected apps
organizer.connectedApps.intro: Apps and AI assistants you have allowed to use your account. Each one acts as you, in every workspace you belong to, with the permissions you approved.
organizer.connectedApps.disconnected: Disconnected. It can no longer get new access, and any access it still holds ends within {lifetime}.
organizer.connectedApps.empty.title: No connected apps
organizer.connectedApps.empty.body: When you connect an AI assistant such as Claude or ChatGPT to your account, it will show up here.
organizer.connectedApps.dates: Approved {approved}{used, select, yes { · last used {lastUsed}} other { · not used yet}}{expiring, select, yes { · expires {expires} unless renewed} other {}}
organizer.connectedApps.footnote: Disconnecting stops an app from getting new access straight away. Access it already holds expires on its own within {lifetime} and cannot be cut short.
auth.heading: Sign in to OpenSignup
auth.login.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a magic link to sign in. No passwords.
auth.login.introWithProviders: Continue with a provider below, or get a magic link by email. No passwords.
auth.login.linkInvalid: That sign-in link is no longer valid. It may have been used already or it may have expired. Request a new one below.
auth.form.sentTo: Link sent to {email}. Check your inbox.
auth.form.errors.invalidEmail: That doesn’t look like a valid email address.
auth.form.errors.rateLimited: Too many sign-in requests. Wait up to an hour. If we already emailed you a link, you can use that.
auth.code.label: Opened the email on another device?
auth.code.hint: Type the six-digit code from the email to sign in here instead.
auth.code.errors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, or click the link in the email.
auth.code.errors.expired: That code has expired. Request a new link.
auth.code.errors.wrong: That code is not right. Check the email and try again.
auth.check.heading: Check your email
auth.check.body: We sent a sign-in link to your inbox. Click it to continue. The link expires in {duration}. This page will move on by itself once you have signed in.
auth.confirm.bodyAs: Click the button below to sign in as {email}.
auth.confirm.body: Click the button below to sign in.
auth.email.subject: Sign in to OpenSignup
auth.email.heading: Sign in to OpenSignup
auth.email.intro: Click the button below to sign in as {email}. This link will expire in {duration}.
auth.email.code: Reading this on a different device? Type this code into the window where you started signing in instead. It works for {duration}:
auth.consent.heading: Allow <host>{domain}</host> to use your {instance} account?
auth.consent.fromNamedApp: {name} from {domain} wants to connect to your account. Only allow it if you trust {domain}.
auth.consent.fromApp: An app from {domain} wants to connect to your account. Only allow it if you trust {domain}.
auth.consent.setUpBySite: {name} was set up by the people who run this site.
auth.consent.sensitive: Participants gave these details to you, not to this app. Only approve if you are comfortable with {domain} handling them.
auth.consent.actsAs: {workspaces, select, many {It acts as you ({email}) in every workspace you belong to and can't do anything you couldn't do yourself.} other {It acts as you ({email}) and can't do anything you couldn't do yourself.}}
auth.consent.disconnect: You can disconnect it at any time from <link>Connected apps</link>.
auth.consent.expired.heading: This connection request has expired
auth.consent.expired.body: Connection requests are only valid for a few minutes, and only in the browser that started them. Nothing was connected. Go back to the application and start again.
auth.consent.decision.tooManyAttempts: Too many connection attempts. Wait {wait} and try again.
auth.consent.decision.failed: Something went wrong recording your decision. Nothing was connected.
auth.scopes.signupsRead: See your signups and their slots
auth.scopes.commitmentsRead: See who has signed up, including their names and email addresses
auth.scopes.offlineAccess: Stay connected without asking you to sign in again
auth.oauthErrors.heading: This connection could not be completed
auth.oauthErrors.intro: The application that sent you here made a request we could not accept.
auth.oauthErrors.noDescription: The request could not be completed.
auth.oauthErrors.nothingConnected: Nothing was connected to your account. Close this window and try again from the application, or <home>go to the home page</home>.
auth.oauthErrors.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Wait {wait} and try again.
